guest.name: 古川さん
guest.role: Owner (マスター) of the old {喫茶店|きっさてん} near レン's cinema in {長野市|ながのし}

title_jp: {雪|ゆき}っぽい{日曜日|にちようび}
context: Sunday 6 December: アルちゃん and レン meet for the first time at the old {喫茶店|きっさてん} near レン's cinema in {長野市|ながのし}. The owner, {古川|ふるかわ}さん, asks if they're friends and レン quickly says yes; then snow starts to fall and レン takes out his film camera.
scene: Sunday night. You tell the story of this afternoon: your first meeting with レン, at the old {喫茶店|きっさてん} in {長野市|ながのし}.

phrases.jp: {心臓|しんぞう|heart (organ)|3}が{ドキドキ||heart pounding|4}してる。
phrases.note: Nerves, excitement or a crush: all ドキドキ.

phrases.jp: なんか{雪|ゆき}っぽい{空|そら}だね。
phrases.en: The sky looks kind of like snow.
phrases.note: Small talk about the weather, very natural.

phrases.jp: {会えて|あえて}うれしかった。
phrases.en: I was so happy to meet you.
phrases.note: The message to send after a first meeting.

phrases.jp: {胸|むね|chest; heart (feelings)|3}がいっぱいです。
phrases.note: Too moved for words: after good news, a kind gesture.

phrases.jp: {初対面|しょたいめん|first meeting|3}なのに、{緊張|きんちょう}しませんでした。
phrases.en: It was our first meeting, but I wasn't nervous.
phrases.note: 〜なのに: 'even though'. Nice to say to someone afterwards.

dialogue_setting: アルちゃん tells the story that night, back under the kotatsu in {鷹ノ原|たかのはら}. One line is the {喫茶店|きっさてん}'s owner, {古川|ふるかわ}さん.

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: {長野駅|ながのえき}に{着いたら|ついたら}、{空|そら}は{灰色|はいいろ|grey|3}で{雪|ゆき}っぽかった。{心臓|しんぞう|heart (organ)|3}がずっと{ドキドキ||heart pounding|4}していた。
dialogue.en: When I got to {長野|ながの} station, the sky was grey and looked like snow. My heart was pounding the whole time.

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: {喫茶店|きっさてん}の{前|まえ}で、レンさんっぽい{人|ひと}が{手|て}を{振って|ふって|to wave|3}いた。{写真|しゃしん}より{背|せ|height|4}が{高かった|たかかった}。
dialogue.en: In front of the coffee shop, someone who looked like レン was waving. He was taller than in his photos.

dialogue.speaker: 古川さん
dialogue.jp: 「お{二人|ふたり}さん、{初対面|しょたいめん|first meeting|3}っぽいね。お{友達|ともだち}？」
dialogue.en: 'You two look like you've only just met. Friends?'

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: レンさんはすぐ「はい、{友達|ともだち}です」と{答えた|こたえた}。ちょっと{寂しかった|さびしかった|lonely, sad|3}けど、{気持ち|きもち}は{分かった|わかった}。
dialogue.en: レン answered straight away, 'Yes, we're friends.' It made me a bit sad, but I understood how he felt.

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: {店内|てんない|inside the shop|3}で{話して|はなして}いると、{外|そと}で{雪|ゆき}が{舞い始めた|まいはじめた|to dance, flutter (snow)|2}。レンさんは{子ども|こども}っぽい{笑顔|えがお}でカメラを{出した|だした}。
dialogue.en: While we were talking inside, snow began to flutter down outside. レン took out his camera with a childlike smile.

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: {帰り|かえり}の{電車|でんしゃ}でも、{胸|むね|chest; heart (feelings)|3}が{温かかった|あたたかかった}。{次|つぎ}は{雪|ゆき}の{山|やま}を{歩こう|あるこう}と{約束|やくそく|promise|4}した。
dialogue.en: Even on the train home, my heart felt warm. We promised to walk in the snowy mountains next time.

listening.intro: At the station, レン says one last thing before your train.

lines.jp: {今日|きょう}は{会えて|あえて}よかった。{雪|ゆき}だから、{気をつけて|きをつけて}{帰って|かえって}ね。
lines.en: I'm glad we met today. It's snowing, so get home safe.

grammar.form: noun + っぽい ({雪|ゆき}っぽい, {子|こ}どもっぽい) · verb ます-stem + っぽい ({忘|わす}れっぽい) · い-adj stem + っぽい ({安|やす}っぽい) · past: っぽかった ({雪|ゆき}っぽかった)
grammar.explanation: Casual 'looks like, -ish'. After a noun it means 'seems to be X' ({雪|ゆき}っぽい{空|そら}) or 'has the feel of X' ({子|こ}どもっぽい, childish). After a verb stem it's a habit: {忘|わす}れっぽい = forgetful. It conjugates like an い-adjective, and is more casual than みたい.

examples.jp: この{服|ふく}、ちょっと{安っぽい|やすっぽい|cheap-looking|3}かな。
examples.en: Does this top look a bit cheap?

examples.jp: {健太|けんた}、{今日|きょう}は{風邪|かぜ}っぽいって。
examples.en: {健太|けんた} says he's feeling like he's got a cold today.

quiz.question: {空|そら}が{暗い|くらい}ね。{雨|あめ}＿＿。
quiz.en: The sky's dark. Looks like rain.
quiz.explain: Noun + っぽい directly: {雨|あめ}っぽい.

quiz_more.question: {昨日|きのう}の{夜|よる}は、{雪|ゆき}＿＿{空|そら}だった。
quiz_more.en: Last night the sky looked like snow.
quiz_more.explain: Before a noun ({空|そら}) use plain っぽい; the past goes at the end: だった.

quiz_more.question: もう{大人|おとな}なのに、{子ども|こども}＿＿ことを{言わないで|いわないで}。
quiz_more.en: You're an adult, so don't say such childish things.
quiz_more.explain: An adult acting like a kid → {子|こ}どもっぽい (childish). {子|こ}どもらしい praises a real child for being a kid.

kanji.where: The wooden sign hanging on the {喫茶店|きっさてん} door; the other side says {準備中|じゅんびちゅう}.
kanji.breakdown: {営業中|えいぎょうちゅう}: 営業 doing business + 中 in the middle of → 'business in progress': open.
kanji.related: {準備中|じゅんびちゅう} = 'getting ready': closed for now. {定休日|ていきゅうび} = regular closing day.

tip.title: 'Just friends', in public
tip.body: Many gay couples in Japan say {友達|ともだち} in public, even to a friendly café owner. It's usually habit and caution, not a comment on you. Later, ask gently who they're open with, so you know what to say.

challenge.prompt: On the train home, レン: 「{今日|きょう}はありがとう。また{会いたい|あいたい}な」 You're over the moon. Which sticker?
challenge.explanation: やった！ shows pure joy that he wants to meet again. ガーン is shock at bad news, うーん… sounds unsure, and {眠|ねむ}い… would sound like you're bored.
challenge.hint: He wants to see you again. Show how happy that makes you.

vocab.note: {灰|はい} ash + {色|いろ} colour. Also グレー.
The organ. Feelings use {心|こころ} or {胸|むね}.
ドキドキする: nerves, excitement or love.
{手|て}を{振|ふ}る = wave. Also: to dump someone ({振|ふ}られた = got dumped).
{背|せ}が{高|たか}い = tall. Not {高|たか}い{人|ひと} alone.
{初|しょ} first + {対面|たいめん} face to face.
On signs: {店内|てんない}でお{召|め}し{上|あ}がりですか = eating in?
Snow, petals or leaves floating down. Poetic but common.
Where feelings live: {胸|むね}がいっぱい, {胸|むね}が{痛|いた}い.
{約束|やくそく}する = promise. Also a plain appointment with friends.

kanji_study.parts: 扌 hand radical + 辰 a clam shell, moving → a hand swinging back and forth: wave, shake.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 震 (quake, as in {地震|じしん}): 震 has 雨 rain on top, 振 has 扌 hand on the left.

kanji_study.parts: 冂 an enclosure + 人 a person stepping in → someone going inside a space: inside.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 肉 (meat): 肉 has two 人 inside, 内 has one.

extras.title: Kinds of snow
extras.intro: Snow country has a word for every kind.

items.note: {粉|こな} powder: dry and light, skiers love it.
Named after peony petals; wet and heavy.
{吹|ふ}く blow + {雪|ゆき}. Don't drive in one.
{雪|ゆき} + {景色|けしき}: perfect for a film camera.

extras.title: Feelings as sounds
extras.title_jp: {気持ち|きもち}のオノマトペ
extras.intro: Japanese often says a feeling with a sound word.

items.note: Before a trip or a date.
Can't sit still while you wait.
